description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.

uses.name: Walking Ballista
uses.cardState: with at least two +1/+1 counters on it
